list_directory.desc: List entries in one directory, or a bounded recursive listing when recursive=true. Use directory_tree first for a cheaper structural overview; use list_directory when you need a more detailed inventory. Recursive calls default-prune common dependency/build directories such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, target, .next, __pycache__, and .venv unless you pass exclude_patterns explicitly. Output is capped by max_entries, so narrow with glob/exclude_patterns before raising caps.

params.path: Directory to list. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden entries, including Windows hidden/system items. Default: false; hidden directories are skipped recursively unless true.
params.max_depth: Maximum recursion depth when recursive=true. Default: 3; 0 lists only the root level.
params.sort_by: Sort siblings by "name" (default) or file "size" descending. Directories remain grouped before files.
params.detail: "names" shows only entry names, "size" (default) adds file sizes, and "full" adds sizes plus modified times.
params.glob: Optional file-name glob such as *.go or *.{ts,tsx}. Applies to files and link leaves; recursive listings prune directories whose visible subtree has no match.
params.exclude_patterns: Optional basename globs to prune before listing, such as node_modules, .git, dist, or *.log. Matching directories are skipped with their contents. If omitted, common dependency/build directories are pruned by default; pass an explicit empty array to disable that default set.
params.max_entries: Maximum entries to return. Default: 500; set 0 for unlimited. Negative values use the default.

create_directory.desc: Create a directory and any missing parent directories. Succeeds without changing anything if the directory already exists.

delete_directory.desc: Delete a directory. Without force, the directory must be empty. With force=true, deletes the entire directory tree irreversibly.

params.path: Directory path to delete. Files are rejected; use delete_file for a single file.
params.force: Delete non-empty directories recursively. Default: false. Treat true as destructive.

directory_tree.desc: Render a recursive visual tree with summary counts. Best for understanding project structure at a glance and usually the cheapest first probe for an unfamiliar repo. Recursive calls default-prune common dependency/build directories such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, target, .next, __pycache__, and .venv unless you pass exclude_patterns explicitly. Output is capped by max_entries; use glob/exclude_patterns to keep large trees readable.

params.max_depth: Maximum depth to display. Default: 3; deeper directories are summarized with ellipses.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden files/directories, including Windows hidden/system items. Default: false.
params.exclude_patterns: Optional basename globs to prune, such as node_modules, .git, dist, or *.log. Matching directories are skipped with their contents. If omitted, common dependency/build directories are pruned by default; pass an explicit empty array to disable that default set.
params.detail: "names" (default) shows only structure, "size" adds file sizes, and "full" adds sizes plus modified times.
params.glob: Optional file-name glob such as *.go. Directories are shown only when they contain matching descendants within max_depth; symlinked directories are labeled but not traversed.
params.max_entries: Maximum entries to return. Default: 500; set 0 for unlimited. Negative values use the default.
